audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua succession, Torah-meditation, and Jordan-preparation text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for succession after Moses, land-boundary rhetoric, courage commands, Torah meditation, officer mobilization, Transjordan obligation, and execution language against dissent.

verses.restored: It was after death of Moses, servant of YHWH, that YHWH spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses' attendant, saying,

familiar.text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

modern.text: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Moses my servant is dead. Now rise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into land I am giving to them, to children of Israel.

familiar.text: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

modern.text: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.

original.text: מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדִּ֖י מֵ֑ת וְעַתָּה֩ ק֨וּם עֲבֹ֜ר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְכָל הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Every place sole of your foot treads I have given to you, as I spoke to Moses.

familiar.text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

modern.text: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.

original.text: כָּל מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם נְתַתִּ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: From wilderness and this Lebanon as far as great river, river Euphrates, all land of Hittites, and as far as Great Sea toward going down of sun shall be your border.

familiar.text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

modern.text: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.

original.text: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר֩ וְהַלְּבָנ֨וֹן הַזֶּ֜ה וְֽעַד הַנָּהָ֧ר הַגָּד֣וֹל נְהַר פְּרָ֗ת כֹּ֚ל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחִתִּ֔ים וְעַד הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֣וֹא הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה גְּבוּלְכֶֽם

verses.restored: No man shall stand before you all days of your life. As I was with Moses, I will be with you; I will not fail you and I will not forsake you.

familiar.text: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

modern.text: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

original.text: לֹֽא יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֶֽךָּ

verses.restored: Be strong and courageous, for you shall cause this people to inherit land I swore to their fathers to give them.

familiar.text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

modern.text: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.

original.text: חֲזַ֖ק וֶאֱמָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תַּנְחִיל֙ אֶת הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶת הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: Only be very strong and courageous, keeping to do according to all Torah/instruction Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn from it right or left, so you may act wisely wherever you go.

familiar.text: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

modern.text: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.

original.text: רַק֩ חֲזַ֨ק וֶֽאֱמַ֜ץ מְאֹ֗ד לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ כְּכָל הַתּוֹרָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוְּךָ֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֔י אַל תָּס֥וּר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔יל בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ

verses.restored: This scroll of Torah shall not depart from your mouth; you shall meditate/murmur in it day and night, so you may keep to do according to all written in it, for then you shall make your way prosper and then you shall act wisely.

familiar.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

modern.text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.

modern.text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.” Joshua Takes Charge

translation_notes: Joshua's authority is explicitly successor authority: he is Moses' former attendant and remains subordinate to Torah rather than replacing it.
The command to meditate or murmur Torah day and night describes embodied recitation joined to practice, not abstract positive thinking.
Courage is repeatedly connected to fidelity, communal responsibility, and leadership under instruction—not aggression or emotional invulnerability.
The expansive land boundaries are ancient promise rhetoric and must not function as modern property deeds or authorization for displacement.
Women, children, and livestock remain east of Jordan while armed men cross; their labor, vulnerability, and lack of voice should remain visible.
Verse 18 authorizes death for disobedience to Joshua and is morally dangerous. It must never justify authoritarian leadership, execution of dissenters, or cultic demands for unquestioning obedience.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 1 to sanctify colonial expansion, militarized courage, authoritarian leadership, or execution for dissent. Center courage disciplined by Torah, shared responsibility, non-dynastic succession, and the promise of presence without turning a leader into an unquestionable ruler.
